items.raw_excerpt: The ABC has learned of a young woman with anorexia nervosa who was prescribed an Ozempic-like drug through a telehealth clinic. Experts say the incident highlights the need for more oversight.
items.summary_en: A young woman with anorexia nervosa was prescribed a GLP-1 weight-loss drug through a telehealth clinic in Australia. items.raw_excerpt: Carolina Rocha viaja al lugar donde se tallan con colores y madera es San Martín Tilcajete, Oaxaca, y conversa con artesanos que dan vida a los alebrijes.
items.summary_en: In this small Zapotec village near Oaxaca, Mexico, artisans hand-carve colorful wooden creatures called alebrijes. Carolina Rocha visited the workshops to meet the craftspeople who bring these magical figures to life. Each alebrije is painted by hand with vivid colors and intricate patterns.

items.raw_excerpt: La rentrée is upon us, so here's a look at this French word which, while it's often translated as merely the start of a new school year, in fact has a cultural significance that goes much deeper.
items.summary_en: The French word 'la rentrée' marks the start of a new school year. But it has a much deeper cultural meaning in France. It is a time when people return to their daily routines and work after the summer holiday.
items.summary_ko: '라 랑트레(la rentrée)'는 프랑스에서 새 학기의 시작을 알리는 말이지만, 문화적으로 더 깊은 의미를 가지고 있습니다. 이는 여름 휴식이 끝나고 사람들이 일상과 일로 돌아가는 시기입니다. 프랑스에서는 이 시기에 모든 것이 다시 시작되는 느낌이 듭니다.
